lord_subset.what: The rows of the wpa-lists job's UNNUMBERED_ENTRIES.csv whose year is 1789-1899 (1,158 of 1,562), copied unchanged. Used when jobs/wpa-lists/output is absent (that job is on branch wpa-lists until merged).
lord_subset.underlying_book: Clifford L. Lord, ed., List and Index of Presidential Executive Orders, Unnumbered Series (New Jersey Historical Records Survey, 1943); HathiTrust, University of Michigan copy; text layer and hashes in jobs/wpa-lists/data/PROVENANCE.json on that branch

other_inputs.stage14_lord_ocr_leads: research/stage14/LORD/LORD_CHRONOLOGICAL_REVIEW_LEADS.csv (1,023 date markers read from the Library of Congress scan of Lord's list, gdc.43013029; dates NOT_AUTHENTICATED)
other_inputs.stage18_curated_candidates: research/stage18/data/EARLY_SOURCE_CANDIDATES.csv (six 1789-1862 candidates with located primary representations, none counted)
other_inputs.richardson_pages_in_repo: jobs/richardson-volumes/data/richardson_v{6,7,9}_pages.jsonl (HathiTrust PDF text layers already held; used instead of downloading those three volumes again)

internet_archive.metadata_api: https://archive.org/metadata/<identifier> (JSON: item metadata and the file list with sizes and sha1/md5 as published by the Archive)
internet_archive.page_text: https://archive.org/download/<identifier>/<identifier>_djvu.xml (DjVuXML: one OBJECT per page image with the OCR words; the job checks its sha1 against the metadata file list)
internet_archive.search_api: https://archive.org/advancedsearch.php (used only to list candidate copies for books whose identifier is not yet known)
